September 2, 2026
VIA ONLINE FILING - Labor and Workforce Development Agency
VIA CERTIFIED MAIL - Pacific Coast Fresh, Inc.
Re: Notice of Labor Code Violations Pursuant to the Private Attorneys General Act (Labor Code section 2699.3) on behalf of Luis Garcia
Our client worked as a packer. Defendant failed to provide compliant meal and rest periods because supervisors required work through lunch, in violation of Labor Code sections 226.7 and 512. Defendant did not pay overtime at the regular rate (sections 510, 1194), failed to reimburse cell phone expenses (section 2802), failed to provide accurate wage statements (section 226), and failed to pay all wages at separation (sections 201, 202, and 203).
